# PushX v0.11.0 - Table of Contents

Modern push notifications for Elixir. Supports Apple APNS and Google FCM
with HTTP/2, JWT authentication, and a clean unified API.

## Pages

- [README](https://pushx.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [AGENTS.md](https://pushx.hexdocs.pm/agents.md)
- [Changelog](https://pushx.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [LICENSE](https://pushx.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [PushX.JWTCache](https://pushx.hexdocs.pm/PushX.JWTCache.md): Cache for short-lived bearer tokens (currently APNS JWTs).

- Core API
  - [PushX](https://pushx.hexdocs.pm/PushX.md): Modern push notifications for Elixir.
  - [PushX.Message](https://pushx.hexdocs.pm/PushX.Message.md): A struct representing a push notification message.
  - [PushX.Response](https://pushx.hexdocs.pm/PushX.Response.md): A struct representing the response from a push notification request.

- Providers
  - [PushX.APNS](https://pushx.hexdocs.pm/PushX.APNS.md): Apple Push Notification Service (APNS) client.
  - [PushX.FCM](https://pushx.hexdocs.pm/PushX.FCM.md): Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) client.

- Runtime Instances
  - [PushX.Instance](https://pushx.hexdocs.pm/PushX.Instance.md): Runtime management of named push notification instances.

- Infrastructure
  - [PushX.Config](https://pushx.hexdocs.pm/PushX.Config.md): Configuration management for PushX.
  - [PushX.Retry](https://pushx.hexdocs.pm/PushX.Retry.md): Retry logic for push notification delivery following Apple and Google best practices.
  - [PushX.Token](https://pushx.hexdocs.pm/PushX.Token.md): Token validation for push notification device tokens.

- Observability
  - [PushX.CircuitBreaker](https://pushx.hexdocs.pm/PushX.CircuitBreaker.md): Circuit breaker for push notification providers.
  - [PushX.RateLimiter](https://pushx.hexdocs.pm/PushX.RateLimiter.md): Client-side rate limiting for push notifications.
  - [PushX.Telemetry](https://pushx.hexdocs.pm/PushX.Telemetry.md): Telemetry integration for PushX.
